root_cause.class: Mixed third-party native operation descriptor contracts between graph constructor and selected CPU worker overlay.
root_cause.old_constructor: The linked reference-windows header advertises ggml_dsv4_hc_pre(ctx,x,weights), same3C arguments as the newer pin. mixed-iq1/source/src/ggml.c:6546-6570 creates F32 result, assigns op/src only and leaves op_params at their defaultzero.
root_cause.new_worker: The actual retained AVX2 selector requests hyle_ggml_cpu_append_hyca.dll. Its staged SHA4b574bc5b1b90d223cc0dd3fa29013320d1198b871a9f401b7b0205542755546 originates in cpu-native-causal/ffa4 and commands.json compiles ffa4/ops.cpp. That function:11555 reads float scale from op_params slot0, :11556 reads gated from slot1, and :11597 writes scale*sum. Zero old params therefore force collapsed outputs tozero even with correct weighted sum.
root_cause.new_matched_constructor: source-e74fc9bb8964d04f/src/ggml.c:6555-6597 writes op_params slot0=scale and slot1=gated, and ordinary ggml_dsv4_hc_pre delegates with scale1.0,false. This matches the retained overlay worker and explains why the same C symbol and sizeof checks did not detect the semantic mismatch.
root_cause.confidence: Source establishes an exact all-zero mechanism consistent with the first observed failing boundary. Root owns native confirmation of the selected DLL and actual first8 op_params bytes. This source audit does not relabel an unrun confirmation as passed.

ruled_out_by_source: Public dense residual[T,4,D] reverses correctly to ggml[D,4,T,1] in create_tensor_input:370-378; dense gate[T,4] to[4,T,1,1]. HyperConnectionPre provider:1127-1129 passes these direct tensors.
Old matched CPU kernel ops.cpp:11269-11312 correctly reads all byte strides and accumulates four stream products per output. It has no scale parameter and would not independently force allzero.

Independent helper hyper_reference computes sum_s residual_s*(sigmoid(mix_s*scale0+base_s)+1e-6), matching fixed06992. CUDA pass supports the composition and oracle, though it is not proof of CPU carrier ABI.
HyperConnectionPre public traits are pure, noalias and dense-F32; no source evidence requires an API/model equation or numerical tolerance change.

lifetime_and_scheduling.facts: CPU provider build marks graph inputs/output roots, ggml allocator reserves caller-owned roots, run binds input/output mapped pointers then bind_views before execution. No definite alias/stride defect was identified in these paths. Sigmoid is a separate supported carrier boundary rather than a native ggml unary in this provider; inspecting its pre4 inputs remains useful only if descriptor confirmation contradicts the scale-zero mechanism.

conclusions.fact: Selected Flash configuration has 45 target layers. Layer44 is KDA, with H4096,64 heads,D128,K4 conv, mHC4, and sparse FFN. A generated-parameter layer44 component is a natural bounded target-to-NextN consumer; it is not all45 layers or original full-model generation.

4H residual streams -> flattened RMS normalization for hc_attn_fn mixing -> affine pre/post and Sinkhorn20 -> actual pre-weighted H collapse -> separate input_layernorm(eps1e-5) -> full KDA projection/conv/recurrence/gated output projection -> attention hc_post using the same original 4H residual, combine and post coefficients.

Attention hc_post produces the FFN residual4H. Recompute hc_ffn_fn mixing from that residual, collapse -> post_attention_layernorm(eps1e-5) -> existing GLM sparse MoE -> FFN hc_post. Attention and FFN mHC parameters are distinct checkpoint roles even when a generated fixture deliberately shares its deterministic mixing construction.

At last layer, hc_contract is four-stream mean, followed by target model.norm. Wrapper supplies no hidden_states_before_norm override; ordinary capture returns this final-normalized target hidden. NextN then applies its own hnorm again. DFLASH auxiliary capture is a different tap and must not be substituted.

For target hidden h_t, the matching NextN embedding is token x_(t+1), not x_t. Prefill worker shifts per-request input_ids left and appends the target next-token id while keeping target hidden rows in original order. Later draft steps use the actual previous draft normalized hidden; each draft step advances its absolute-position cursor. Do not merge target token position, shifted NextN cache position, and lagging indexer produced-through cursor into a single unlabelled number.

mHC4 streams are per-token residual data across layers. They are prefix results/taps, not temporal recurrence for the next token. Next token consumes its own actual preceding-layer streams; only KDA matrix and raw conv history feed back temporally in this target component.

confirmed: f_a->f_b and g_a->g_b have no intervening activation.
Q/K normalization is x/sqrt(sum(x*x)+1e-6). Existing RMSNorm epsilon1e-6/128 and gamma1/sqrt128 is mathematically equivalent.
KDA gate is per-key-channel -5*sigmoid(exp(A_log_head)*(forget_projection+dt_bias_channel)); beta is sigmoid of one scalar per value head.
Recurrence state is FP32 [B,Hv,Dv,Dk], decayed along key axis. GatedDeltaNet already applies output 1/sqrt(Dk), so do not add a second scale.
Output per-head RMSNorm eps1e-5 then sigmoid(g_b(g_a(input))) then o_proj.
Conv state must contain the last three raw projected QKV rows [3,24576], not convolved or SiLU outputs.
